title: 2025 Celsius
body:
The day Amazon University stopped public admissions, the world turned to watch. The freshman became library assistants, so the librarians could start reading again. Tech Support was moved to the admissions building where they reached out to every past alumni to 2FA. The decree stated that, nobody could graduate unless they found someone else to take over their work and they’ve taught what they’ve learned to proficiency. To combat the insidious ambivalence rampant among all the world’s inhabitants, especially among students, instead of watching one another struggle the ones who wanted to get out, had to make sure they found a worthy replacement and trained them because nobody wanted to be billed for their pupils shortcomings on their yearly alumni taxes.  Alternatively, students at the university were given the option to marry one another for a permanent faculty position. Alumni took bets on who would graduate when, to raise money. The weight rooms became cleaner, and they got rid of the roaches in the kitchen. The food got better, and people lined up to pay for the leftovers rather than let it go to waste. Skyscrapers were built around the campus using anonymous donations so nobody had to use public transportation to get to campus. Money was spent on proper equipment and regular maintenance was not out of the ordinary.

There’s less drinking and more passing- more hydration and less gaslighting.

The administration who once found fish to fry, now have students where they once had assistants. The faculty has as much help as they need and everyone is well-rested. Lectures have become fortune cookies since information became free and lecturers the pilots of robots. The teams closed practice once they started competing for actual money, and the squads opened rehearsals. They changed their colors from red and blue to purple.  The dining hall became a palace and the auditorium a colosseum. The labs turned to alumni  funding, and didn’t depend on the government to allow the science. The ambulances started leaving campus because all the nursing students were doctors. The government declared it a national park and the streets within miles turned into Renaissance fairs. Student unions became labor unions. The ones who never left made the most money, as they were the ones who could get people out the fastest- it’s only right that they collect the most tuition. The dean was given a seat in parliament, and the Vice President, a podium.  The engineering students fought over dirty dishes to wash. The dish washers worked from home and were given plaques on their walls and dealt only in precious metals. Me, I was just passing through on the way to my car.

Then it happened. Everywhere else started to get worse. Without anything to aspire to, the poor got sick and the cocky got fat. Anyone with any money saw its value plummet and became understandably hostile. Strangers started testing one another on the streets whenever they looked away from their robots. Poets became novelists. Coders became secret agents contracted to the highest bidder. Ideas became grounds for blackmail and a poem became a last will and testament; a singularity.

title: Scaffolds in the Sky
body:
Am I wrong to look for scaffolds in the sky?

Rather, should I see at what my inboxs block out of my mind?

Should I watch the potatoes as they fry

On the way to interviews, I try to ignore these useless lines that form as I’m passing by.

The day you can follow plans using only your hands, they’ll make a chair for your eyes

Without a map to the maze, you can get anywhere with waze but inside.

I studied eggs before brains, when all I ever needed was to ride the train

and avoid the gazes

Though I looked up and have never stopped paying

What can I say, when I’m too depressed to cry?

How much is it worth to have Suzie and Uranus at noon-

Or to learn from Sadie what’s in each degree of the moon?

I can drive to Saturn but it always ends too soon

Everyone I see is steeped in misery whether they’re living on cardboard or can afford to fly.

 Drive if it’s nobody’s fault, unless there’s violence that only feet can avoid

It’s only fate that my choices have led me to your mercy, and destiny that has kept me devoid.

Why they continue to rehearse me-

Who is being subversive?

It’s just easier it seems, to let me drown in silence

So then let me build my scaffolds in the sky

I’ll be <<ccing>> you

When all my best ideas crumble to bits

When my nerves are gone and instead of throwing fits-

When my voice can’t carry my words because nobody in life seems to give two shits once they’ve got the check

My capacity to balance- context, post and pre- with reasonably guarded expectations, has gridlocked me in conundrum

It’s not fair for me to get what makes me happy, only to be teased with what could be

It’s only true that you can be in a better place

than I could ever be

Is it so much for me to get some cat time

Before I’m back out on the front line

I can pay for therapy or streaming

Either one stops me from screaming

Remember that omelette, I made?

With hands on fire-

Before the great conjunction

With that look in my eyes?

Now that one must click to stay alive,

The type to type are the ones to demand what’s in demand

There are those that do, and those that try

I’m the one that’s damned and I know why

If nothing I’ve done matters, we’re all in trouble.

But not as much trouble as if they keep me from I’m meant to do

How can I prove the existence of this lack of doubt in my mind

When all I can find is scaffolds in the sky

If I’ve really been pinned to a t, it’s time to see what else you can get from me

Before I figure out why

As I reside in dignity, in awe of how it’s aligned

Proud of Dr. Manhattan on Mars, while it’s in my water sign

While even the mighty Satun faulters, until the 27th degree of Pisces, at least it’s got Neptune to sing along with

Until Pluto’s back in Aquarius on my Mothers birthday

You never realized, that I saw you just to stay alive- if you had you would’ve tried

Instead, you let me built my scaffolds in the sky

title: Elephant Gun
body:
Save Her

I’ve never been in love, I’ve only ever been in pain

You can shoot me out of the sky just with the things you say

I planned on anandamide

Not more NMDA

Put me out of my misery with an elephant gun and do it today

You fashion a facist with faulty preparation

Try to Facet a Passivist, in any situation-

Don’t lose your cool, and beware of your indoctrination.

It’s only human to be wrong, but it’s divine to try to make bliss

Don’t doctor up the resignation with a bite

Just stop asking how to fix a sadistic nation, starting tonight

Put me out of my misery with an elephant gun and don’t miss

I’ve seen the eagle fly and land

On my way to the great falls

littered with broken bones

Called the lion’s roar outside and inside of every door

How can you expect someone who can’t breathe to answer calls from you

Just put me in a room and let me leave

How can I ask for more?

Put me out of my misery with an elephant gun before I do

Or you can make me a drink

Have it yourself if you’re on the brink

Who tells who what to think?

Someone with an elephant gun

title: Eclipsed
body:
Just what I need, another poem

To put me at 100, when all I need to do is say I’m sorry to a sold out crowd.

Now in the mire,

maybe I’ll go back and re-read

Those times when I was painted in the shroud of a champion

Before everything I’ve done was undid

By my own foolish actions, and the land slid into solution.

I used to feel like I had so much to share

beyond the ceiling wax and redemption songs to mop up the blood with filtration.

Now I can only take refuge in the capacity of love.

Screams to evaporate the doubting voices

which fill the subway cars and streets-

Something to rectify the lack of control over my life- that which I gave away for a chance to distill a dream; A decade with the same zippo, sounds through my phone, and my underwhelmed team.

To those I’ve buried with my thoughts of separation; I’ve only sought to rectify

my silly frustration and narcotic innovations- to set the pressure and remove the oxygen to foster calcination.

Soon air will be free, once I lose my turbinates again and I’m be able to continue comixion without the rainfall of fists that stole my voice.

It’s cost a lot to learn not to waste what I’ve bought; knowledge of the aquarium.

It’s roaring mountains and cliffs, waterfalls, roads and doors that scrape the sky, and eyes to hide behind

I can’t help but wonder what would’ve happened if I hadn’t lost track of who knows what-

Or if I ever had control of plans or choices

How might the yield of purification of will have been affected-

If I would’ve been able to listen better

If words hadn’t taken a toll

If I hadn’t lost track on purpose

to suit my own demands for space

to ease my damaged mind and face

Sure, give the dragon a year and take a lifetime

To get used to the disappointment of existence for the favor of a heart.

Ad infinitum.

Every prodding word which nodded towards curing of the curd, assumed the state without considering uncertainty

of the space between confinement.

Cursing the seeming perpetuance of 2020’s inhibition;

10 billion ghosts ferment the normalcy of cruelty, perforating the tolerance for malfeasance and justifying the diffusion of responsibility towards selfish fixation.

Anyone can explain Multiplication

and division as the same function;

Depending on the inverse numbers-

But to live it

Is astoundingly terrifying

Every room has always been for improvement, mine is for refinement-

Faith to a t, and not a letter more

Those words, ideas and feelings;

The ones we got all wrong

were nothing short of perfection,

only fodder to protect the never ending simulation

Now that there’s a tortured poets department, I can finally resign.

title: Rosemary pines
body:
Rosemary pines for Rosemary pines

To see to feel to taste

Just when life turns grey, she reaches for the paint

She’ll think of you no matter what you do

There’s no telling where time went in haste when you’re In Rosemary Pines and Rosemary pines sooth

Welcome to Rosemary pines

Have a sip if

You think you’ve got it in your mind

what’s true? No matter which way you run, It’s love and then you flip and lie

On the line to Rosemary pines.

Can you feel it in your spine?

If you’ve had too much to think

You may be in Rosemary pines

Rosemary pines Rosemary pines

She wants to dissolve in oil

Is it better when she’s fine?

Or when she’s got a bouquet to put away her toil underneath a line

Thinking she only goes with beef

What’s underneath?

In Rosemary pines to which Rosemary pines she bequeaths.

Measure with the moonlight

She just can’t be rubbed wrong

Happiness gained is never lost

Fall under her spell, you won’t have to tell

for long

In Rosemary pines

How much was your cost, did you win a fight

For admission to Rosemary pines?

Look me up if you’ve got the time of night, I’ll be in Rosemary Pines

title: Poisonberry pie
body:
What’s in a recipe?

You overlook the best of me.

What is love and what has it done with the rest of my life?

While I work on the crust, say what you must

Don’t you wonder why I eat the poison berry pie

Join me in the fire

Just don’t burn the Poisonberry pie

Poison berry pie poison berry pie

 There’s not much else I want because I want to die

I just wish you could appreciate like me

Not ask for more than I can give or why

Or get in my way- What’s yours today?

Instead of dying

Think of me tonight and

Poisonberry pie

Don’t you want the recipe on how to try

I’ll chop the onions so nobody cries

And you can poison away like you

always do everything else before my eyes

If I’ve not got your name tattooed on my heart- have a slice to ease the pain

 and sigh

Poison berry pie poison berry pie

 There’s not much else I want because I want to die

I just wish you could appreciate like me

Not ask for more than I can give or why

Help me, don’t get in my way and make me want to fight

Think of me tonight…

and poison berry pie

I’ll chew the leftover oats

While they fight over pigs and goats

Just show me where it’s at-

Something to numb the pain.

I won’t waste the antidotes

Flour salt sugar fat,

AP wheat or rye, egg or flax, you’re nothing but a dream in wax

Once you see life and death in a pan

Have a slice of Poisonberry pie

With a dash of cream, don’t forget the jam

Never make it the same

I’ll just make poison berry pie instead of going insane

Poison berry pie poison berry pie

 There’s not much else I want because I want to die

I just wish you would treat me like me

Not someone who who’s dumb or shy

Maybe then I’d start to want to live and start to fly

But everything’s out of sight except

Poison berry pie

title: Fissure lines
body:
Fissure lines. I’m looking at fissure lines

How else do you think I should spend my time?

Why do they bother to lie in rhyme?

What’s being taken from your wallet?

Or taken from your bed

Who am I -to question an alabi?

When you can act like it never happened

Instead of try

sweeping the breadcrumbs under their ties with somersaults and sighs

What can I bring you from space

My faults- nerds doing somersaults

How much can you buy?

You won’t look me in the eyes

When you cry

This is why I want to die

You’d rather hide but I’d rather bite your face

Do what you can to get through the night

It’s alright that it’s not alright

In fact it’s quite a disgrace

Just take a piece of me that I couldn’t hold

Before you get in line to do what you’re told

Before we start feeling old over

Fissure lines

I’m staring at a disguise trapped in time

A folly that was mine

An opposition and a trine

As the degree awaits

a jolly change on a dime

Now, who needs who more ?

Eclipsed by leaves and brine

Who needs more nothing?

Seething but I’m fine.

My love only echoes the moon, in its shadow.

You can see me rising through to my bones

But do you only want the marrow?

Hurry up and film my movie

I’ve already got a line

Now we can focus on what is hers

Forget about what is mine

Fissure lines- I'm looking at fissure lines

It’s not just how they define their crimes

A count down till I get my box of limes

Till then I’m looking at fissure lines.

title: Saddle up Sally
body:
It’s a long way to Cali, don’t drown- you're almost home

They may bite the steps you take, But they'll never keep you down while you're alone- while we're together-you and the weather, can take it all on loan

Saddle up sally before the horse has lost its legs

What used to be a crime, now they’ll just slip by and force you to beg

So saddle up sally like it's your only place- why complain, just pick a lane

You may forget the things they say but the pain's still written on your face in vain

So Saddle up Sally, take in all you can on this go-around

It’d take them forever just to get down this tally, so dance the night away- knock yourself out with sound

Don't you count the ones you love, turn the other other cheek and don’t you frown

They took all your life just to keep you in need, saddle up Sally, yes indeed. Go to town

Saddle up Sally but don't fade away- they want that fire your eyes, it's true

no matter what they say-They'll push you every time you turn today

Don’t you ever question why they send you away-Good years? At least You've had a few.

You can live wherever if you never sign a lease, hold and release-Peace is overdue

Saddle up Sally-Don't pause for the applause. It's what's best for you and your dreams- your cause. Don't you listen to silence without it's seams in sand: it's in your hands even if it didn't quite turn out the way you planned- whatever that means...

So saddle up sally, the summers almost gone- or else go on display

Nobody wants to be Bonnie or Clyde anyway- just ride

Just somebody and somebody -It’s so fine to have a place to hide. Even if Love’s just a lobby- have you earned your pride?

Saddle up Sally- go find another hobby- too close to the sun and you got burned ? You decide.

title: Tools of the trade
body:
Isn’t it nice to be a professional

You and the Tools of the trade-

Let’s make this issue congressional- if you can tell, how much has been wasted

Unless you are afraid of the numbers in cells, the games we play, or what's been tasted, or how it started to fade

Isn’t it nice until they’re not- no matter how happy you are- you’ll still hurt a lot

Who’d have knew I needed the memory of you - especially when they fade

It’s who you are it’s who you are it’s who you are- not me

The soul wants what it wants what it wants- you'll see

Cruel and usual- a spell that’s Perpetual

It’s quite exceptional a person of your talent and skill,

how death they’ll put you at test until you shake and you spill

Just to turn you to a spade from the window sill

Fun- can't you catch a drift?

Learning how to be humble from the crest of a rift

Isn't it nice to belong? Well then sift.

Movers don’t be shakers, actors don’t be fakers

See me and wave, but watch out for the breakers

Everything’s fine.

title: This time
body:
Lilith’s back in Leo

To form an imaginary trio

With a overgrown bovidae who’s almost done with her debacle.

They used to throw stars at me

Now I only dust away the rubble.

As I try not to hear what they say

I’m tickled by the suns beard because I’ve learned to work along with its horns

Needing every dollar I ever had, the future always mourns because it’s taken more than everything to almost capture infinity.

Its only right that 3 or 4 times a year,

One’s buried past becomes more clear-

For now as Hermes fights off the hooves and the tail. May light prevail and spark the revival of occluded words that couldn’t be said because they were eclipsed by numbers

it was easier to disappear among the saints and paints than to scurry among the blunders

Nothing is fine until there’s division.

There’s two months until 6 months to spurn decision before Capricorn’s last stand in Hades.

I’m only glad I wasn’t born in the 80’s.

title: Elementary, Mon Ami.
body:
Who?

You and your retrograde amnesia…

 You can’t even hide in your dreams.

Girl, you better change that tune you’re singing

before you say what you think I mean.

Who’s more afraid of who

Who would take the dare of two?

After you? Who only took everything I had

Worth nothing to broken eyes,

But everything to a pair who knew-

It’s on you to speak what’s true

(but you never do.)

Like you knew me before I met you.

Everything will be golden if they let me live, just to breath the Mercurial air.

Saturn is of Earth, but more so of terre;

So as the Moon is in every drop of Water…

How can I remember to forget everything I left over there-

Now slumbering in the solar system’s fiercest storm, now that it’s home and I don’t need everything I have to stay warm,

Run and warn Destiny’s daughter.

The only thing I can use is silence to forgive everyone else’s pain

One at a time, repeatedly, including myself, believing it is-

Find her and bring her to me, and get me away from him.

Love doesn’t stop for evil, but we can slow it down,

with maybe in the way.

For one to expect at least resistance, no matter what they say.

title: Heavens
body:
It's funny how scrambled they were before everyone knew where the sun was always.

Who would want to do without the love one couldn't possibly imagine?

I don't know how they thought it paradise.

The first time someone realized Mercury was in Taurus- over razed ground-

It was way too late for humanity to stop its own annihilation, so these ideas as repairations; fermented and multiplied, futily map our course towards infinity-

Fueled by the dismantling of countable aberrations.

The first eyes to see Venus outshine the moon stayed awake through noon sharing with every other pair a taste of the parity- who knew who saw with clarity, the firmenant of the sky?

Even I thought Mars was one of the stars, before Saturn started the age of air.

Tears of fire taught Jupiter and Neptune not to compare, to conserve the chemistry

induced by Uranus partial backdrop, the difference between material and matter

If the past has given us anything, it's a thing we can share, and the future might be tared more pleasantly. Let me know when you’re there.

title: Hide from me
body:
Hide from me

Pry from oui- least of all; Sweet Surrender

Perhaps there's nothing left for me where I'm not wanted. Nevermind what was taken- from broken on a bender.

Wasn't I the one who prepared them for the cruelty that you flaunted? Before I ever said a word-

There's so much more to give, that their foolery is inconsequential, and any further action would be utterly absurd.

Hide from them.

By now you should know how that goes

Piss and tears as sure as the years

But if I cite the evidence you'll...

Mock my bravery- taunt my depravity

Cut my лосось before it's seared.

Incite my rage upon the page because the truth would hurt your ears

Go ahead and fire, I'll have to dig up the dirt for your graves either way.

Nobody counts the giant steps you've taken they just let you fall after they've gotten out of your day, or died in your maze.

Go ahead and disassemble my mélange

I don't care if it's my record or not that you exponge- I've still got this rubble of bridges, planks and lunges- no thanks to the fumbles and Midges, please stop your hedges and binges- see sanity hinges on what they want you to say, and their bets.

Can we see through the hailstorm of bullets at why people have nothing better to do but get so angry- as the button pushers have lost control of the machine, though they mean to be leading the way?

It's in their chairs as much as their stares-Why shouldn't everyone have a seat that can stand all day to meet?

As for the pay, why would the mountain maker create mole hills for you when you steal the dirt out from under calloused feet?

title: Visitor’s Pass
body:
Make a decision, any decision- I've been here eager to see you try to bring the sun inside,

this time the light seems to have caught on- This time we share- fast and slow- has expired and what have you left me besides to hide?

This sneak peak premiere because we just have to know for desire-

It’s the same old show here with the same old cast, now they bow as they near, but the mast is In the fire.

Would you like a visitor's pass? To go and come as you please? Someone had to pay for gas, but you’ll make them pay for your disease?

Should I show you to the floor, or show you to the ground- to wallow in the pound just to let time pass where it’s safe from their sounds.

Golden debutant; how’d you like the queens water; the door to quagmire- would it kill you to love me more? How much could it cost to care? More to sire?

I guess it’s just easier to take the visitors pass and stay a liar over there.

You should’ve just said you wanted a visitor’s pass, not let them all add up

Never noticed you were why they all ran away because you weren’t looking to stay, rather looking at the cups.

The only Perilous journey- safe arrival at love’s door. Just to lead me to a rival and leave me wanting more…

Left before the milk went bad, but you're why you couldn't breathe like I’m to blame for how the pentacles dirtied my mind

To ride the silent shame.

Three arcs created a loop of swords- an ephemeral weave.

Never stopped for love because all you wanted was a visitor’s pass for free

title: Frag
body:
There’s a perfect vessel to do what you can’t.

It only costs blood to run.

We’re still looking for any use for the ides.

But what of those who spurn the word?

I've got a better one-

for whom possibility is louder than reality and can't compare- you can only lose your temper

 choosing sides.

Every vow done silently is simply unexplainable, one is retainable in duality.

New neutrality paints the way back in lacking finality, and in else, not much.

You take me out of every element, undercutting anything I could say with triviality.

As if the animal in me cares about the consequences of the words of municipality.

I've got more never then I ever knew I had; To care... to touch…

I’ve got two who always know what to do like laugh at the news, but they don't look at the tread of their shoes to decide what's true or ask why- one can never put into words; what's not said, only try.

I've got one left. As far as existence goes...if this were it- how many does one need not to quit-

Citizen emeritus; throw another dare at us, ask the jungle if it can share.

Speak to the knife and it's size, and relish when you're there.

Not even Google knows what to do with potato eyes, only how not to betray silence.

title: The price of one
body:
Can it be done? This prime arithmetic?

The way you try so hard to make me feel

the moon. At least you should know, I’ll stay till you say to go- No matter what, the words always seem to spell too soon.

Without hope, I hold onto the shoddy illusions that our days are more than numbered.

The price of one is more than who you are and what’s been done- at least you can say you’ve had some fun among the undead.

Everyone’s got a type- what can I say? More than a Capricornian gripe.

How much to get one my way?

Seems I’m always waiting on your call.

Like your shirt is daring for a stripe in dye.

Do you want another? Or do you want it all

We’d like to know. The answer is rather daft, like Cancer being after Gemini.

It’s just not free- a new way to spell money

Even when she’s just a girl,

By god she’s a woman; to see

At least I'll try for you, what will it take for you to try for me?

This is what the money is for- for sure

Not a dollar more

Tell me- what’s the price of one?

title: Incomplete dominance
body:
Heart’s on shuffle till it knows what to play, it’s all they give to me for free-

Can’t remember to forget how many things to do in a day, won’t you make me pay in blood again, merci?

 I know you’re not all you do at least in one way, more of what you could be if you didn't run away when I slow down

I may let you dominate me, but not all the way, pound for pound it's what’s true, just today- there’s more than one crown to drown the flu.

Let’s both be expressed, I may be wrong but I see you being oppressed and constrained- these thoughts in our brains and these pitiful attempts at explain-nation are deranged, and all truths constrained and replaced.

It’s not codominance, see them wail for prominence, while we make the most of our space.

Virtruvian room

Let’s have a good day for once with camera glasses, this time, it always passes through the column vents on zoom eluding pretext on descent; You can always call a meeting, but I know how it went, at who’s expense.

title: A Eulogy for a ring
body:
She always knew I could sing, so she held silence against me- now I’m cashing in my breath-

I guess I’d let you see what I could bring if you didn't do everything to prevent me here- just as you always dissapear this time of year while the breads baking, everyone around is shaking and I'm daring to keep my head ringing free from a lonely death

I'll trade all my cool for some heat, the emperor for the fool- to cash out when we meet by the pool… of blood, but now the stars are caked in muddy red and I’ve started to seize; freezing in the flood

Parlay these genes by any means,

Life is bursting at the seams, anyway

There’s a lot to lose and more to say

How much should I spend so you get your way?

This is a eulogy for a ring

One to kill the King

You hold the price of the only freedom,

I’d rather hear you than cha-ching

I've got no freedom left to spare so I'll trade a ring for a kiss of death- that’s the thing- there’s always another breath

title: Thirty Wonders
body:
We'll always have green silence

And the flies dying for a whiff- to which I leave the most painful decade of my life.

I traded every maybe, but only for what if. What's your reason to strife?

Holding on forever, I'm breaking down now. But I'm sure you'll need to; Act your doubts away, talk less towards what’s true and more about how...

Is it wrong that I haven't grown tired of hurting you, or that I’ve learned to unfeel-

These moments of rapture nearly floor me without purporting- because I’m still stuck on the lives that were given up for sorting... know the deal.

How can I implore me to profound happiness- the way I’d like to when instead I need? Like any insight is new...

While every ship is fleeting, nothing you say can assure me so instead I bite you.

What’s it worth to be around- if just to be found out- With and without sound I've said I love you to a shadow of a doubt.

Somehow these thoughts appear, I don’t know who put them here- will you let them tell you what to do?

 There’s always fury to protect against the madness- all that happened... I'll show you the mercy of letting you forget, then you can begin. Temperance was left on the 14th floor, thousands of pages in- If you want my words, tell me where to begin.

I wonder how to reclaim perfection spent- not if I’ve seen the best of me or where time went.

title: Superfluoust
body:
I'm a superfluoust

To stop myself from falling more deeply in love

just to wonder what I missed.

Though all I can do is delay your inevitable return- your time; I may earn? What is this.

 Helpless in the field as the Florist, after all there's always a surest guess

 to break the press and test the rest of reality- watching it go bonkers; equilibrium between love and neutrality.

How much have I placed on forever- is it enough to give it another try not to disregard? It always melts on guard, not on I.

as the earth continues to burn... As if I were born a Gemini- a day too late to catch the air from these tears, a stare is their fear. Grasping for the shard; awakening the lion in it's cage to laugh and take for granted survival, further yet that I have brought you near to fall with my burrowing sigh like I've fallen with every card, now I wonder about the dial, not the water or sky- now that I have your permission to fly, I’ll never stop falling.

They’ll only ever reach me in the ways they can think to; me thinks they need them all.

This line to nowhere grows louder the longer you’re away, to file or to call...

I truly was alone in my mind- next to yours

and I lost track of time behind the doors

It's not true what they say about denial, I know, but not how you took silence.

It’s only all I ever wanted to hear- like my own dying words. At least I listen to them but I must ignore the misplaced violence.

title: Perils of civility
body:
It seems like this years character is in love

See the way he screams into silence.

Hear the surprise in the way he seems not alone

but paying heed to the feeling that last year's patchwork didn't quite cover what’s been sewn.

This time around- ther'll be less displaced blood, discrepancy, and again you make me laugh off the written word as you charge to take your ground- war unlocked with regency

Yeah right you don’t love me- that’s just what you’d say on loan to surrender.

I love you like it’s going out of style- it’s the only way like shining to be shown to plunder

To completion- complete destruction of their combustible bubble of diplomacy.

Let them have their trouble while we bask in knowing; we’ll have our day, what they can’t take away among all this fuss about the rubble- need another be you?

Sadie’s always kept the sheets from growing cold but I’m growing too old to care about where the wind blows all these ways to say I’ll tell you when I see you...

To face the same river differently

What else to plan but to remember you vividly from this pain of stupidity.

I’m building a meta-jungle- a primal refuge from the perils of civility.

Whatever is necessary to preserve the time machine.

title: It sway
body:
I saw its face in a dream. An idea not yet named

Perhaps it's been betrayed- a game that can't be played until you forget how- Like the parts of the boat that you don't appreciate until the water rises and there's no bow. Better yet are the things you can't forget like the silence in between the sets, the shame of going through all these tests, or the threshold of pain that's forever rising- dropping like flies- We're all made vets on the bright side of the moon.

The proof is in the breeze and the solution- dirtied by the colony, couraged but solemly never close enough. Forever inches thee nearer- straight fun dose of touch approaching asymptotal kindness carved from darkness disconnected from it's call.

Beware of 23rd degree Gemini, just as the stars lept from her eyes into the skies- just to break free from the lies and cries and bets- to keep the ones that actually land held offshore for days left only to count the ways how fire and water make sand.

It's not like I haven't had my heart broken before, or tried to stay awake

I've never claimed a new start, just know I'll never be okay or ever break.

Someone's got to say "don't fret" just to define art-

Anyone who's seen energy flow can always make.

After all, its always been listen to know ye- obey or betray this silence.

The answer is and always will be; love like there's nothing else to do but violence.

I don't know why they continue to watch to see of one to tell their play

You built the only road to my heart- It would be an insult to say

 you know the way

title: Yestalgia
body:
Insult laid out my jeans and bolted all the locks.

Spite didn't bother to ball up my socks. It's funny to me that they think there's so much more to do than holding on a rock. Still they talk and something that resembles words leaves me when it's time to feel absurd- this itch it scratches these double latches you secured. Dangling the keys, the facade you fein patches and I'm floored.

They can only handle my love in batches- what about you? Taste ye the curd?

Theres always these scribbles to quell this pain, unadjectifiabe.

It cooks the air in a good way, like the first taste of that perfect mix, like what more can something say, that's as palpable as this.

The monster you know; Indeed appliable. Chemistry undeniable but only a guess.

Would you buy not selling it, or give it away? Have we yet reconsidered what is need.

Perhaps my ban has been lifted- Aye, May may never know what to do with a seed

When April is here, will you remember snow? What it's like for life to feel blessed.

A year into reply, all I can do is sigh- yes you're too far it's true.

All this distance and you. How can one not mind all these divides- what to take-home how many lives? Last I checked, death is waiting around the corner, what reason do I to face it- don't say I didn't warn her that one can only place it in stride.

 I've lived so long on indefinite hereafter, so numb to the tears I can't hear the laughter of the love that ruins everything.

Call it Yestalgia from your bed of coals.

title: Silly
body:
If it’s good for you, it's too good to be true. Every step laughs tears until born is Sue.

It's been this way all my years and never twice the same- call it what you know and you've already won the game and this bonus silence to relish until the next crest.

All I know is love, it's been forever and just won't undo- they just gather until it sears.

Granted, existence for its own sake slashes any belief beckoned for- whew knew.

What's reckoned? Yet you may return. Along with freedom. Wearing that timeless style and news of how you treat the burn, and then the door and a smile... The years...

Lost count last return of how much you made me earn- when the dancing stopped along with the new news of what's to lose. Lest let's set- more fit to forget.

Coffee is Vegas, wine is Paris- I haven't shone my shoes just yet, though I just might.

The nerve; of this joyful pain on this perfect forever plane, no matter what happens out of sight.

I need to have you every day till eternity, or however long it takes to turn a t

Does it not embarrass that it’s all for you? I'll laugh if you believe it's for me.

I chose you, you chose to go. Oh no.

This time... how silly.

title: Parsnacks perhaps
body:
Maybe the stars are wrong, and nothing can be anything here in it's place, but somewhere called night, just before right, rotting warm and clear embrace- but don't sleep so long that we're on Nereid, harnessing hydration from space.

Perhaps theres a chance that the crux of the forward force of evolution has gone unnoticed in lieu of the battle for another's happiness and place.

Perhaps it's time for everyone to feel better for free in spite of me, and for these inapt rough appropriations of reality to fall under the sruitny now reserved for squashing progress to be redirected towards silence; whilst the sun still carries water-

I feel Ike it's not too soon to revisit the moon cloaked in robes, countless layers of dreamwind to peel for the countess and her self-evidence of infinite lifetimes; destiny's daughter.

Ask about her relationship with nocturnal Jupiter, and it's participants as if there's anything to be known about imprudence but ways of negotiating with the winds of Cupid and ignoring might, air and aperture.

Likely, there's a less fearful solution, one beyond shallow restitution, yet it seems the screams of gridlock echo through the fallen shade, we had it made straight through the rapture to Altair in Aquila.

Maybe the stars are wrong if they never seem to repeat as they dance out of sight among the rafters to ignore, they're gone; more luminous future is there to implore us.

Beyond probably, our momentum is solvably expansive, though justifiably each glance towards me is a blight on such a perfect fight- 132 parsecs till Atlas (in Taurus).

title: Cold pans
body:
What happens when one loses hope;

then what's found in what is ; left, behind, ahead?

Whatever that is to you, know there's a way to make it work, whatever that means.

I've had to answer so many times, laughably true, as if hope ever mattered to you

Feeling so soluble, lucky to know my hydrogen bonds are more than carbon copies,

and much more plentiful than my reasons not to get sloppy.

I wonder what we could have been if I made a stronger solar play, if I didn't turn to the stars and the cards to paint my way, if I didn't let you go on believing in the words they say-

  Go ahead and try to land on Neptune with a loaner, not today;

if these strings and things were more than clay- nitrogens fixed alkyly, so polar.

They’ve taken the neckaces off on the necks of then maniquens and now have facemask-rash clinics, and I'm still crunching popcorn gazing at the wheel keeping the seal from the wasteland and sunlight to be nice, each day redefining cynic.

What happens when those who were only taught to overlook, face a gaze unyielding, when the words start dancing from the book; swimming phase, but they've got buoys in the waves.

There was a sale on laundry detergent but no price, sometimes I'm glad there's some of a poem written- I don't know where it comes from, perhaps the PFC functions on its own, limbic existence, living in the zone;vice.

I heard hold the phone, call me when every footstep isn't bitten and be nice.

Eyes have I breached? Saturn's better than Jupiter to teach, I'd pass on your hook but I'm smitten. Above all by fall, if I have my way I'll be curled up with my kitten.

title: Soul battles
body:
Occasionally, I'm swept off my feet by sensation, leave it to an idle mind-

Mad to think of you, but its what I seem to do.

Unfortunate silence is what I find.

Maybe a train will find traction, still too frozen for action

somehow I'm pulling through.

This intercepted moon, what should have been my 10th house; eclipsed, stolen by fixed earth. Which words to take away from your lips, two more for what it's worth.

With so many delicious parcels to wrap your eyes into disguise, I'm buzzing like flies.

Your honor to besmirch; mine in tow of your disgression, perhaps this scorched scape gives the wrong impression.

We should be flying from devestation, but we've let our wings congeal gazing up at the eternal zine.

I am in love with the devil of manifestation,

in incongruous terms, mine.

Break my heart a little further, maybe that will help.

What good would it do- to think of you and all the times that I've said welp.

I've decided to grow the first beard of my life for Pisces perhaps I'll trim it with my knife.

Before I explain second noon, the firmament of the sky, you must know that fire and earth are contained by water and air between Mercury and the moon.

I didn't know either.

Jupiter above, Saturn below. What else should you know?

It's transverse to Ether.

 It's the threshold that keeps the night from falling too soon.

Each planet's energy transmuted by the darkness across;

IOD of spirit transformed to HE of substance,

 like reflecting to December from June.

he', it's parallel pal in essence transmutes to material as OU.

What else do I think when I'm on the brink, besides me and you

Besides "don't talk about alchemy", I can't remember rule number Two.

title: A summon
body:
I can still make myself laugh

When I think about my past decisions to write anything at all, and how I lost count before I ever started to dream about suspense

What evolved in the brain so recently to allow for transcendence of chain of events

How there’s a sentence button in my mind that I can press, no matter the state and one to match it with a rhyme, as long as the machine vents

Perfection manifested by cups, perpetuated by wands, while swords temper the air, and a pentacle absconds, it may seem rather tense.

It will all of happened

As Pluto will leave 284 years behind in three, finally breaching air

And Neptune leaving it's home in four for 164, still this poem will be there.

At least Jupiter and Saturn's red shift paints the air until March when Mars meets it's twin. Meanwhile, Selene is yet to be born- still gazing into Mercury's mirror, air gauntlets worn- sure of the scorn, the dark is clearer- For the quicksilver filter substantializes material before your very eyes- if Mars and Venus clash, who would win.

I'm ending two poems in a row with the word begin.

title: Desire
body:
Some resist submission, funny to fight the snow

Despite protestation- some without- more or less elation, and then there’s light- what’s more to know-A position on life like this?

 Answer as if it's a new configuration.

Just short of Devi Station- this levied nation- in need of resuscitation. What is.

Sipping chips in my glass, this nothing happens so fast and this nowhere is chased away. I wonder what who will do- what they have to say, drifting-

Lifting the burden of the hey.

What is just this way, just this way, after one, before the end...

Surely better ways to dispense time appear when there’s less to spend.

Perhaps I relish my methods too much among the chaos and miss out on the lightning

Maybe I wish my demeanor were less pensive and more inviting-

 pardon the pardon

After all sometimes life runs amok in the garden.

 Perhaps this visceral rage is embarrassingly blurring the lines on my face- somewhere along the shine; the taste-

Erasing the path in cobwebs shaping those motions from yesterday’s place; frightening

How could one see less in nothing, tracing these shapes laughably in forever’s ether

After how long one starts to wonder, naturally about the sea and its rise, the darkness in another’s eyes, what to love and what to despise. I can’t hold back the laugh, or bring myself to look at the graph or the slope which spells that it will be much too long until together.

Gathering Bulls I pray for a feline Pisces, though an Aries would be fire

What can I control in this chaos? This eternal question, what is desire.

title: Love too many
body:
What's one more love song, like another reason

You are the warmth I feel, the fire in my sky, the magic of every season, every reason

You are the stars burned in my eyes as I see there's more to peel and arrange

If we're not in love, then the moon doesn't fall, the morningstar won't rise-

who knows why- I’ll never know the reason, you know the deal, it’s strange.

How many loves in a love song certainly not too few, one for every crest-

What's another thing, not said to regret or forget to forgo, what’s in jest

Anyone can think it’s all wrong, and anyone can bet, what can we do?

Is it so?

I’d tell you every second I love you if time would permiss

 How would you know? When every attempt at words is a miss

Yes, but not like this, when each and every I love you changes with the kiss

I've said it to a mirror to you and to me, when I don't know what to do, I think of what can be

I loved you yesterday, I love you today, till who knows when but it's the only way

What's one more love song anyway

It seems so simple to say, like tomorrow just too far to stay, so my thoughts are with you and with what time got away

I love you like inter dimensional travel, sure to unravel fast, my love is that way- for you to hold or pass - I’ve never loved like you, so slow and so fast

It's easier to sing I love you, so I'll love you long after I'm gone- so much in a touch

I can't bring myself to look down or turn back- like there was another way but to go on - cut me some slack- there’s no rush to reach the day

What's one more love song anyway

While my heart can still sing- before I can look tomorrow’s taken you away

My night- I love you now, it's alright - I laugh when I ask myself when did we begin

I want to be with you always. What more can I say. What more can I bring

When I hear your voice, it’s my only choice.

It's just one more love song, then we can begin.

title: Rhetorical Answer
body:
Three people in a room

You’ve better have a good reason for the surprise

I see you when the clouds obscure the sky with treason, then I can surmise;

about where I’d be if I didn’t stop for the season- weather or not love was there-

The unlucky asphyxiated as the privileged secured the cage with sophisticated idiocy, blindly dismissing justified rage- while every drop of freedom, squeezed from open minds forced into binds-

"here's some fear and cash for your freedom, tear gas for your cheers, since you don't know how to breathe safely we'll swab you for years"

Now, how to act when every action laughs at it's own folly- truth or dare?

 let them sue the winter for cold for Dolly

Way too late to believe light is true; it snaps the lies they tell to bleed your hair

However much time has passed since happiness loomed has long ceased mattering

In theory, keeping the heart in free fall keeps it from splattering, the call; inevitable.

If one ever had a choice it’s to catalyze joy from dreary- it’s all amenable.

The world will let you think you know, we are the chosen, until the realization that we are the ones who choose, yet they are the ones who think only they know- the ones I’d care to lose.

I only wish you were the type to change your mind once it’s set, but I know better than to ask you to- though for your own sake there’s space between your lips and mine- I just can’t bail you out every time.

It’s just so copacetic, scratching rips in the air for no one- or rather one who knows

In stride- that if nobody was watching one wouldn’t have to hide.

title: Reverse Post-descent
body:
Today I resolve and revolve;

That it’s not too late- at a later date

My love will be better; better for who?

You’re still too far away though you know the way- I’ve brought it to you so many times

Dwindling calcium ions; crawling to my plastic plasma distiller which only purifies

Cold opening; through smooth evaporation of the slope of lies.

Frigid winds too cowardly to face a day without words describing how the sparks fly; tapping in to be well prepared

marks on an endless wheel- rather reel.

Seize those dark photons and flickering phantoms rectifying reorganization

Prize those eyes that bring you to a now- wear that hair that takes you through a never, but first be.

Reprise those sites in your mind it’s mercy; Mercury in Rewind

However well you know the train, it only matters if you know when it’s coming

This first cut stung more than I remember. This time in limbo- what will I find?

Where more bites mean I love you

Liquefies so; Purifies such

Is it this bad or worse for everyone else?

Hydra laughs as the moon plows forward

Surely the earth would be there to catch it but it’s too busy falling.

title: The First unspoken rule
body:
Residing in Essence

Distilling and purifying by evaporation

Ignoring my own presence

The seems to be a new principal in town

Who thinks he can rule for me

Not me, not alone

Born free to the bone

Expanding to the stars ever since.

Nocturnal Mars has much more power in an earth sign than its diurnal state, especially with the synthesis of the moon joining in Taurus

That's what's holding everything back until our fixed air is rectified

And there's Pluto holding the door, not turning to look, but hearing echoing wails

The so called Age of air, well, it's right there

They take from me like I take light from the sun; petrified.

Any configuration can spell- it’s done-

I’m finding magic in pronunciation and Solution.

title: Year of Lemonade
body:
One more for the ages!

Again for the Times?

Give us some milk and we’ll give you some rhymes

Enough with the nonsense enough with the guilt

Had enough yet? Perhaps you’re on tilt

What’s in your belly- is that what’s in your mind?

They’ll just take, but me I just find

What’s in the clock? Is it getting late?

I live in a world where every doors closed to a date

Love is the question and love is the answer

I know when I’m done I’ll have made you a dancer

I should retire in the face of all this work

Instead I’ll watch the world going bezerk

The facts remain that this may be the year of lemons, or the year of Lemonade.

title: Commercial
body:
There’s a million reasons we shouldn’t be

Wouldn’t you like to know

The pain I’ve left behind- it which you still go

How unfair to demand that it be fair-

Then call it land of the fee!

We are, so far so much more than you can be

Without fear, it’s here- the right of individual superiority if not lost; the disbelief of the sheer is-one’s priority.

I see no reason to best you in the ways that you are best, yet my silence you criticize like I have to pass your test- as if I’m blind to humility.

Still try as I might, it hurts to feel perpetually.

Who am I to say “it’s not so” with fear ?

I can ask Jupiter and Saturn why they disappear, or tell that nobody alive will ever forget, with perfect vision, Mars’ dance through Aries. What a year.

Those many still drinking light must remember the fight, with those that chase live away; need to keep trying to dare.

Meanwhile I’m replying emulation to remind myself what it’s like for someone to care

For everyone who still rues these new rules- trapped in the torture of their circumstance in relation to another, I extend an empathetic sigh. Fearing it won’t get better for anyone

Put that in a commercial- at least we can try.

title: Purhaps
body:
Perhaps the extent of ones constraints are the beginnings of our limitless expansive capabilities and the chance to archaise the many fates we’ve resigned.

With resolve, negativity is redistributed in divine proportions but only with awareness approaching Infinitum, both accepting and rejecting what’s been designed.

What will become of this rubble-

Only if you take it in your own hands to form away the bleakness of the deniable reality that eventually, it’s all lost in the sand.

What choice does one have but to attempt in vain- when no matter how hard you listen, it may seem the same, though only the past is bland.

Still the value of pleasant distraction, that which keeps you in traction is the gate. Belief is action and the only defense against them is your brain and your ability to wait.

No matter how appealing, actualizing is your greatest fate; Nevertheless, one is always to blame-

The boundless fear orchestrated by the safety of this lonesome fear just may resolve accordingly. Now what's to stop you, mate? After all, it's only a game.

title: Couche Saturnienne
body:
Why should I kill you

before it’s your time

Isn’t my fake smile enough to enlighten

The breadth of the trine or how it’s the only thing that doesn’t fade where all else is doomed

If only sight and your philosophy was less fearful, love would less tearful, not assumed.

If it’s not plumed, you can keep your earful

Either way, I’ll be pleasantly exhumed.

As careful as one can be just wasn’t enough

I’m dreaming of ways to make existing less rough- to any avail as the betrayal of descent- did you say what they said or say what you meant?

It’s easier to forget what’s not mentioned-

In building plans, the snow contrived into orchestrated gusts buy time

While helpless to sit and watch the clouds form and divorce from the cusps of devine

Fun; antiquating books; as love is losing track of the course in a dire storm

as if it’s the only way out, in configuration, the only thing sure is there’s no way back from devastation if it’s warm.

You need more evidence of my shortcomings, as much as I need your pain

As it is now, I can only lend you my shorthairs, ears and my tears or lend you my brain.

title: @ Life
body:
See “myself” for whom I’m really working;

If you only exist to make someone miserable you’re missing the point of living.

Whether or not you accept facts, I’m giving.

My world gives me multitudes that I cannot say.

If the release of my pain ever brought you your own, that was not my intent- and my persona is a reflection of what you’ve led me to believe those times you came and went.

Remember each time a rhyme helped you to vent. This infinite perspective is never spent.

See who fastened the chains that you accepted out of fear lest ye be resigned to false guilt. At least someone will own the laughter from this powerful life I’ve built, but I’d be able to give you more if you didn’t keep me on tilt.

You deserve more than the fruits of breadcrumb sins. Please see your freedom is more important than who wins.

You’ll always be the reason why my heart cries or sings.

title: Obsidian
body:
The second I decide to finally expand my 8 sequence map, the movie, the show, whatever people would actually pay attention to these days... Life makes it obsolete.

It was quite good I might add- DAMN good.

You don’t deserve it.

Though, I must say it’s not the same without you.

Everything has changed. I just can’t accept that there was nothing we could do.

To hold the world within my grasp- feeling it crushing back makes me quiver.

One is never enough especially when the math seems wrong. Always another equation to deliver.

These words do more than distract to break its infinite weight.

Everyone serves to obscure from your true mission, to conquer your way, but only the date.

All I can do is never enough to show how much someone who cares is worth.

“It only depends how I feel.”

You both love her

But not her alone.

Imagine what I don’t write down...

Once you know the taste- is it better hot or cold?

In society that challenges every choice, all you really have is your voice and how you’re growing old.

I rue that I ever knew perfection because now I cannot help but feel completely all this love-tainted pain. This rage that burns inside at the disregard of the sanctity of life bleeds from us all but only you can choose to make it stop. There’s always another plane.

I plead with you to see that anguish uninflected only causes more for everyone, as every heart is affected.

It seems I’m out of tears today, I’ve never felt so small.

I pray that going forward we can address it all.

It a great burden, and a greater honor to be at your disgression.

title: Unresponse
body:
Fuck you privilege. Fuck you power. Fuck you sweet? Or Fuck you sour?

“All you have to do is not fuck it up.”

Every time I hear this type of silence, it’s a signal to let me know I’m about to be abandoned again.

This usually follows acts of stupidity and my futile attempts for rectification with them.

It’s about understanding how hot seems cold when you’re not bold, and that nobody doesn’t fold. There’s only one two to a name. They’re together, but not completely. Refrain.

I’ll forever be in awe of how you empower and deplete me with pestilence, It’s tame.

Try a fraction as hard as i

I’ll never be able to win your game, so protected by the bulwark, that’s why I play my own- carefully inductively crafted by your lack of rules tempered to my nature and will to survive my quirks.

Mature by mother, taste to uncover, you can only love Her as long as you’re alive.

title: Applea
body:
These are Alkylizing times

Chewing through these hash embargo rules.

Newly considering prenuptials; There’s only so many fish for fabricating and cups for fools.

I’ll defend you with my last breath though I’d breathe easier if you didn’t need defending

I just can’t write a story with no ending.

If you still think I need imagination more than you- you must not notice anything I do.

Grasping at straws like I’m not bigger than Jaws, I fear we can’t move on if you’re too concerned with what’s true.

Don’t forget this is a poem, but more so a fountain, how many different mediums do you need to climb the mountain?

Where are all these writers I hear about?

It’s as if they’re in eclipse. A million pages deep; yet now I can only think about your lips.

title: All
body:
It was all wrong

Just after you ruined it for me again and again so that it could be perfect.

So I return to the bunker with my army of poets with nothing to eat but delicious misery and garlic-this is so big, it takes an infinite number of minds to know its about time for a new relic. Since you ignore my body...

It will be better because it is now.

I’ll trash this poem- but how?

With or without action-

Only a woman

Could explain this look in my eyes and insensitivity to pain

Only a woman, you say, but you really only know her name

Only a woman, I’ll repeat it again until I believe

Because girl, only a woman would stay, and only a woman would leave.

It’s all right, it’s alright.

I don’t need another to face the night.

What’s in sight- another bite?

I taste love but you just want another fight.

title: Pascals of consciousness
body:
Tonight’s beauty calls an end to the harvest- a blessing to get through the night while it’s at its darkest. Silence cracking at its edges, I reap the crest of hedges to call you closer, without expecting reply. No use of prospecting at why...

Hide the magic before they can ruin it.

Give me a telepathic secret;

Sequester before it gets away.

How you’re tracing the consequences of waveform of your perception in the medium before you, before we, but after them; the future you’re still singing to is as real as the silence.

Hide the magic before it’s spell is broken.

Hasten the nodes, prepare for the crest with a quip-

Will health win out over wealth? As long as there's another to grip-

I’ve been thinking about things, in that forever place of nowhere; never alone.

What ever happened to hominy since I've been home with astrology; as more evidence of my err is the light.

However fast this current brings, it only takes the chili from the air.

Activation energy is best when contained until the elucidation catalysis of the rains.

Rather than tip the hand that holds the world, to sip the sand until the earth curls perpetuates abyssal power.

How much to share to clear the air before the next shower? I'll try being nice

The answer is as clear as Desdemona, I just plead I won't live this twice.

title: Addendum
body:
With dying thoughts we’ll always think

“I love you”

How valid are yours, see that’s the true mystery of life- one which has claimed.

That’s so nice. You’ve got a better vice.

Me, I’ll laugh with forever whether or not you disclose your thoughts of expiration from your shrinking cage.

There’s much I don’t know- you say without a single source- the best way to make me look dumb is to ignore the fall of this scending discourse.

This capacity of mine to elucidate, cultivated while you were so swiftly doing another’s beckoning, would serve you best if it’s not ignored- though I can only be responsible for the light, not how much you choose to open your eyes or your doors.

However high your bottom dollar bounces, lies don't change how much an ounce is-

But you never even consider the phase. I can only bring you what you can carry and since you won't let me show you what you have, I'll have to build a maze.

For disambiguation consider how you keep your planets in order with your linear dilution. I just wish I always knew that Saturn chases Jupiter and Mars, and only Venus and Mercury dance with the moon.

Worth ignored is an act of aggression- What’s only yours is discretion.

title: Chocolate cake
body:
I’ve been practicing with silence

Because what I have to say seems to need to be said each day

I feel so gracious as to allow you to take some time to think about what you should say

Frankly, the lackluster nature of your replies

Is dwarfed only by that look in your eyes that negotiates me towards extortion.

The mind behind, the mind behind them-that mind that defines when: It’s your day beau, and your night too- boo. Ask yourself if there’s anyone who always knows what to do

I'll be number two for you as long as you know you're number one

But when you forget that fact and fall, I won't be brought down too, I'll run.

My price for advice- don’t act like you never knew you’d have to pay to hide from the sun.

This vibrational mine, between the earth and the water; this light and that time- grasping for order is all that's not distraction.

You only need belief to be in traction- meanwhile if you've seen trial you know you've got the floor until redaction.

Perhaps we'll stop being Ill when it's time for action.

title: Nuclear Decay
body:
Dear pour it on sweeter

It’s in your hair, I know you don’t care who pays for your heater

Playing a non believer who won’t let me prove I’m not a cheater, cursing the minds that set out to deplete her

Let’s try it again neater

When you’re not glued to the battery

Can’t you see them play the moon like strings and discard things like it’s not what they need?

It’s difficult to reckon your blindsided speech

I suppose I assumed you’d know more about seeds, and how we each don’t respond well to flattery

I so freely share this index to my puzzle, to guide from tears to nuzzle, fully knowing its futility in decipherability.

Contemporaneous duality in triplicate, this mind we share is intricate and must be tempered with nuclear silence before the decay of fruitity

Oh, these days; words, beeps, tears, and screams, call teeth, claws and dreams softly through muddled laughter

There’s never been a day you did or didn’t say I love you, so why do you buy the fallacy, “hereafter”?

There’s always so much more to say but be mindful of who you bury with forever

Let me give away what’s only mine, while we’re stuck in trine- the only thing that I can promise is divine endeavor.

title: Friend Greg
body:
This troubling notion builds as my reality and yours are reckoned with every bite

Perhaps this charm has found you too-

It seems there’s much overlooked by sight.

I am what karma beckoned- my judgement which you spurn at every turn has taken me, fit as a fiddle to the protractible plane of night

What I've found upon returning has robbed me of desire for terrestrial vision:

Love by induction, my latest deduction

Her latest reason to run amuck into the night; shun.

Pulling through late, just in time, a rare plea for mercy, still I'm only thirsty and remain unquenched.

Well call it something beautiful by any other name.

Nothing feels quite as bad as getting benched- one daring you to unclench so they can take your fame

This label can be removed and applied ad Libra with minimal degredation;

Whereas I'm much more permeant, like a scar on your thigh, a needle that never quite reaches the surface of your eye, which is why I'm still shocked every time you try to reply.

Well, what did you bring to and from Babylon and the Golden City?

Did your words transmute to add or aid the echoes of hatred, could they not bring to light anything that fate did?

What’s clear to me, it seems that too much is lost in translation, at a loss, why you still feel the need to keep me in the dark, though I still appreciate their feigning ignorance.

“Why are you laughing?” I thought I saw a sin of omission dripping from your nose.

When their fear stops becoming entertaining-

By that time the sump should stop draining platinum puddles, the bets of vets will go unwon- Meanwhile it’s all rubble and knots left undone, as life is a futile attempt at denying the inevitable asymptote approaching one.

title: Creation
body:
Creation just because there's something new to name

You already know life without love, why not see all that's pending

I know you feel the need to protest, but why keep on going at all, in vain

It's just a simple pivot- to a new blind spot, obscuring triviality, spurning complacency and individuality to a point of absurd bliss for long enough to sustain the foolish heart and mind from the grasping lonely silence long enough to arrive at a fleeting place of assured calm.

Going forward, these bluffs of theirs will become less triggering to the clip- they'll be more to do and less time for figuring, as I forge a ring from blood and tears; and sweat, I sip. All this love you insist you need, you'll have that too, then there's the seed- damned to ride the water

Now I seat to learn to spell; out what these blasted symbols are screaming, all this just to keep dreaming grasping for splash in this ever widening stream of consciousness

Perhaps what's next will have meaning, however attributed, rationality prohibited. Perfection can only be one way at a time, at first. In the second it's upended- somehow the polarities have flipped. In the subsequent chaos, I may be maddening, but at least I'll be well equipped.

I'm back from 5, 000 years ago with significant news of perpetual incoherance-

That favorable confirmations are not favorable to all and that each waveform of consciousness only has in common a rise, peak and fall-surviving is aligning, and some have the capacity sometimes to grasp it all.

title: I do declare
body:
I feel the urge to record your silence because of whats said

Just so I can play it back for you to know your cruelty and to have evidence for my sanitytizers sake

Lest not we forget the muddled nature of all minds, clear to me from the guided cage.

There’s nothing you can do to break my heart and you should stop trying

Though shoulds never work.

I’m at my wits end with you and this is when I can begin again

Let them mumble at me more, I just can’t hear you past this roaring fury, same old story, Gorey allegory.

I wonder why I still waste my spells on your protection- if just to point the flame in your procrustean direction.

I'm laughing like Chronos Neith this ever mounting capricornian kernal, invoking the forces of heaven to shake this stagnant earth that finds every way to make me bleed

It's not worth wasting thought on the scrambling of vermin, unless of course that's how you're earning...

I can't see what's so perplexing about paradise.

title: Sumerian Summer
body:
“Sumerian summer”,

Someone spoke, but not to ears so far

sometimes what you’re not is more valuable than what you are.

In the realms of nothing, what you have never means as much as what your heart desires, the quest for what’s mine.

When everything is all you have, everyone fades away unless you give away the line; that which I could afford to lose from this grid; if just to distract from all the things I did

And so I plead with you, and what there’s left to do; to align with the greater design and stop trying to figure out what’s true.

This concept of “my heart” must evolve

This process of so called nourishment that’s spoken of in English must be exposed for the farce it really is.

Selfishness and desire make an infinite task of knowing what you’re feeding what.

Hunger and pain fighting over higher faculties and self preservation, behind the scenes as one dares away Enemie’s disguise.

For all the times I become unhinged, you have a hold on me like strings, so I can become ideas until you so kindly bring me back to earth.

Somehow along the way I stopped walking the offbeaten trail and became it.

title: Rate
body:
I used to think there was a point of no return

But it was a myth to freeze people in place, while effigies keep spinning.

I used to think I’d live to earn and I’ve turned out to live for space

Who's winning?

Can I call you baby?

If you get lost, tune into love

It’s not so far away.

I realize I am the torture they fear, sculpted in form benevolently from all the pain they’ve inflicted.

I've grown as long as, the lie; "what you want is here but you’re free to look and see for yourself."

All this darkness and distance, and not a doubt in my mind that somewhere, someone’s as capable of love as I.

It’s you darling, it has to be

If it looks as good to you as it does to me

Inhibition, solution, rectification-

Guess the phase I’m in-

Deconcentrating the substrate with planets and time until my inevitable return

It's the plan I can only show you, for if I speak it starts to burn.

Evaporation, Distillation, Solution

I can't see how you'd doubt the purity of my constitution.

Like Mars doesn't see Venus in trine, I don't even need a sip of wine.

The devils trick is convincing one of his existence beyond 2 dimensions.

You'll never know joy if you're too obsessed with pain prevention-

Dear, it’s clear malfeasance, how could you leave me in their hands?

Lucky for me I can take to the skies when I'm not tethered to your eyes

meanwhile he's still looking for Neptune's sands.

Nobody only ever asked to love someone;

Without possibly knowing it’s implications for more than one day; Truth is most move on.

It would be so easy, but never is.

I still can’t believe you think you’re his.

If only one could create the will to create, and creations erased distance and time instead of destroying them; Two wouldn’t be so temporary.

title: Precedente
body:
Consider your strategy ubiquitous

Honest devotion without considering it's pending evaporation

Practicing accountability without a possibility of resignation

Perhaps your ZIP code is not on your address- Suppose only love is progress

Know they'll raise you if you should ever fall too far-

As the momentum of beauty continues it's metamorphosis you may cease to recognize for some moments and forgot it's your choice to notice when to stop turning away

Only you can set Love's precedent for the ones who still follow, and are still convinced that hearts are hollow

Meanwhile it's all for the taking with questions standing precariously daring to be laughed away

Thank you guardians of the night for reminding me of despair-

And the ways I've learned to deal with provocation, and still maintain care.

You're welcome vixens of the season- as if I need another reason to take what's mine- Though all that intrigues is not...

We've both got wandering eyes, with my head in the clouds- what's between me and her thigh.

A little bit at a time to rectify expected returns from ripening dreams...

It’s my money it’s my money

It’s my money it’s my money

Those images that tease of the future are my favorite- not ones that try to encapsulate the past, or the calls to get home too fast-

Enjoying the present, dreary or delightful

A quest to keep the night full;

I’ve adapted this stance for copaceticism

Giving my free will to nobody because nobody will take what’s really there.

Your composure unsettles me, though maybe we’re both just too sedated to see

It’s my money it’s my money

It’s my money it’s my money

Catfish fishing; infer what's missing;

Don't you know that good night is worth your life and all it's floors

Just use the conspiracy that’s in place to damn you;

to remind yourself that their constraints aren’t yours.

title: Goodbye July
body:
Indifferent discourse

I wonder why you ask me to lie

Perhaps it’s because you believe that there’s

Some sort of truth in words

Perhaps the details of dharma have been obscured-

Suppose souls persist without belief-

Incarnation is not instant, and without confluence begins incarceration.

Purport this impending capricornicopia

Decompose these prime numbers into

Fibonacciable elements, and when nothing finds you, keep looking.

In the interim, I’ll be reaching into infinity to reclaim the timeless methods of defeating the flippancy of English and hoping you can read passed the news.

I hope I can laugh off words that don’t speak to progress, turning to the minds that have seen through the most broken human times, relearning how I exist for more than supreming limes.

I’ll return to this river again when my moon falls and I resume my rise. I wish you the fondest window and the coldest floor.

Just don’t group me in with those who confuse the ceiling with the skies.

title: For fiction
body:
If just for fiction, remember the real scorn for your convictions.

Succinct as a typical day, as you write me off in your particular way-

It seems as though you’d prefer

I’d word it in a different way...

Perhaps because you’re not afraid to get yours;

but only because you’ve been fooled to think that you’ve gotten what you wanted before.

This is no shortcut, no casual endeavor; re-routing the words that are meant for your ears into cyber permanent obscurity, with the hope that you’ll read enough of this or that which matters, to be as on the line as I.

All this silence we’ve exchanged, couldn’t be worth more. In case we come out of this deranged, just know I never forgot what all these holds were for.

I’ll plan for us, though I’m unlucky enough not to know who, and certain that if you want a dancer instead, I wouldn’t be happy with you.

title: I won’t forget
body:
No matter what

I can’t forget how to love you

Instead I’ll just transmute it in different ways

Since you take the power from my words

I’ll learn instead aspected phrase

Dwindling in distraction,

protecting and skepting

For what must be days.

Sleep and a shave can save any soul

While I still have a moment, before the Scorpio moon’s toll; all for another go around.

If I’m sure of anything;

it’s we’ll have our time. But knowing;

nothing has served me so well

As lending you my ears, tuning to the swell

projections give me some years to yield further significant returns- still it burns to see all the steps between the locks.

Meanwhile the armada of clocks echo with silence bursting at the seams, as I work to pin down the planetary coordinates of each dream;

Like the flavor- the last in my control

I’d trade all these gleaming troves; though not for anything, Not even the ripcord.

That feeling once again, the one where I’m not one

How it rises and falls with the setting sun

Before the night beckons it’s calls.

title: Nobody should be as divided as I
body:
If you have one to justify anything you do

You can do it all and never have to worry until the fall

Till then I'm joyously melting till I'm viscous enough to call

I believe you still know the way

Which makes all the more ridiculous each word we say

Damn this time apart because your prospect is so dear, and when you're near!-

Either way it feels like we share forever

So I see no reason not to only walk towards open doors

Seeing how as soon as I arise I'm washed up on your shores

and all the creatures already know me

I'm not one to complain

about time moving slowly.

Who will turn the machine- without a question- just like what's to become of you and I; one with momentum.

Maybe in September I'll liberate the albatross... if the bell tolls again.

There I go again, looking forward backwards

Not denying these cyclic dreams as I lend you to the moon again among my unreal estate

While the sun's at home swimming through the moon, I'm keeping tabs and making projections on changing lives through noon, escaping agony scorned situationale dripping in tempid awareness as it escalates.

How much to show- there's nothing to hide

How much to know- never enough

How much to make.

My next task, To stop the bequeated dreaming by pushing up the atmosphere from underneath

As the brokering of nation's falls to individual love to grab ahold of or perish.

title: Death of the metrocard
body:
I awoke from a dream where I was late for class because I was manifesting a totem of the season.

As I strolled into the classroom to take my seat in the third row in the middle column, right side,

Le professore says to me in English, “way to be a Libra”. I replied, “you’re reflecting”;

was handed a workbook from the conspecific in front of me and said thank you in the worst Italian I could manage. I was a Virgo.

I woke up to see the flood spreading to the garden and scrambled to keep from evaporating.

It was as easy as a double tap and I cried out in exaltation, “the metrocard is dead!”

Knowing then, that everything that’s ever resulted from a swipe is now a bittersweet memory makes me want to reach into my volumes and dig up the crux of the importance of the little yellow flap of plastic- especially, given my recent discovery.

I called out to the tired and the broken just as loud as the ones who have; the ones who tore holes in my shoes, and the all the ones who’ve pleaded with humanity for a chance to be plastic for the night.

I bid the memory fare well, of the words “insufficient balance” to keep me from reeling back to the darkness like the hold I just couldn’t grab in time.

I can still hear the echoes of urgency of the hops which I had no choice but to take, to reach the places in time to save my life routinely.

It feels like a step forward and a sign that it might be okay again if literally everything gets as better- and the fool admits and resigns; that the quorum is what will lead us from shambles towards Landcashair

title: More today
body:
More of today

Less yesterday

Give me tomorrow

And I’ll be blessed to say

There’s no way to contain this.

If they silence and dismember me, I’ll blink the lies away.

I’m just pleased another day has passed

One step closer towards making diamonds out of these Hollywood squares.

I can’t afford to bet, but I can take a dare

It’s just what I’ve got, and I’ll be damned if I don’t share- Although I’m fresh out of maybes

Life must be more than manipulation and babies and pride.

title: Come on.
body:
Come on, let’s see

An excercise in futility

As tomorrow's temperature falls fast

Life and lives begin to matter more

Cultivating control of space and humidity;

I refuse to be a part of the putridity of dangerous negligent malfeasance.

It’s good thing I feel like waiting for you

to grow, though I don’t know why I do.

What a shame if it all were to fall through...

Meanwhile in the meantime I work on myself because that’s all that I can do whilst waiting for you to realize it’s been days since the departure of the Gemini moon.

If you need it, it’s in the bag, if you need me I’ll be here waiting for you it’s true- why you’ve left, that’s on you. You should know it’s not just you that I look up to. And most of the time while we’re trying to build, you undo.

Let’s not be sorry; yes, I’m talking to you and you. I don’t want your story-

just for you to do what you know you have to do.

The light is free and so are we, but you’ve too close a grip on fear, so I’ve got to let you be.
