If you’re near me you’ll hear Amy and Billie-

I’m not concerned with the question “Will he?”

title: Worse than she is
body:
Only she can be worse than she is,

as long as she’s the judge who approves the nudge.

She won’t listen to a man who knows her

though she just might have it all anyway,

She’s had it. These pitiful offerings they throw her way do nothing to sedate her the way they’re intended to. And the pleasantness with how she begrudgingly reciprocates serves as enough of a distraction to fend them off until she can make it more perfect.

I don’t envy your task, Ms. and Mr. today.

Instead I place my worries silently where they belong; in my clouds to rain another day.

They can’t touch the ground you stand on

So don’t let them try. Here’s to hoping you really have what you planned on and that your clouds have enough sky and you’ll always have tears to cry.

July's blisters, make sweeter August's whispers.

Not to say that as a man I have any sort of right to her or her sisters.

title: Kind
body:
The kind of mind I'm seeking

Will see through everything

Go ahead and keep talking, I'll only interrupt with the truth.

I am the peaceful warrior, these days;

Undaunted with another's perceptions

To my own peril and avail.

Do it my way, give it a try.

Show me everything, in my direction.

You can't take me anywhere the light doesn’t burn;

Let me take you everywhere the waters churn.

The human universe will retaliate accordingly when falling in love, proportional to the magnitude.

My bruises from striking the earth shape the flesh of humankind

Into what? We won’t know till I’m done, will we.

You have more to do with it than you think.

Wax on, feral moon! the world seems

to turn beneath our shores. The wind though-

that’s mine and the rain is yours.

And so they are the clouds sometimes and it’s fun to bounce the light around you-

As they filter out what gets through.

What prefrontal cortex could keep track of all these astral transactions-building only on procedural memory in the dark with the veil of consciousness preventing help from getting to the terrestrial plane.

Luckily I’ve got gloom at my side to remind me that I never had a choice.

Then there’s this pen and paper that the omnipotent over-mind can’t yet see.

I can’t wait. Someone’s left and another is about to leave and they haven’t even arrived. Let’s just all do what we want without regard!

Sounds like a bitter recipe to me.

So what first place isn’t good enough for you? You always have a way with rubbing it in. While you gamble with your life I’m staring at an empty plate. Life. That’s great.

title: the way
body:
You vanquish your foes the way you blow your nose

And how you will speak of love this time and make use of the silence between is of much less importance than you believe it to be.

Your attention. That's what's crucial.

If I'm known best for wasting time, then I'll have won.

I just feel regretful for one ones who think they can reach me or breach me.

Can't they find a more rewarding game to play?

Because they want to remind me they exist for reasons not immediately clear.

We'll, if you really wanted me to do what you want me to, you'd be here.

Won't you show me the difference between triviality and insignificance as I'm resigned to the task of eye opening because all I want to do is close my eyes.

If I've ever shown you anything but love- to me it's a surprise.

title: American tooth.
body:
It’s a lucky guess that there could be a place to be free- You’re a fool, I would know.

It just seems like there has to be...

Today, I want nothing to do with the warped agenda unconcerned with life.

I refuse to hear anything about this great nation while it’s in shambles.

The people who make it great are dying and the ones who want it to stop are at the risk of being ignored.

The screams for freedom will echo vociferously as they always have.

Your choice remains whether you coalesce or let them be drowned out by the ramparts.

Take a dare from my red glare, watch the stars do their work, but don’t miss how they earned their stripes.

Are you here to take the world from the berserk or hide behind a nations gripes?

As long as liberty be, there exists an equal and opposite force.

All I’m asking that hatred be finally granted it’s bitter divorce.

That’s right, I was born and will die free. Since, far too many have died in captivity.

Climb and wave with the flag while you help melt the ice;

Give it a go, then try again twice.

Say, does that box yet flicker with news of suspension?

Some are more concerned with those letters and numbers on the ticker, lest we continue to futility collapse into two dimensions.

How lucky to live in a time where not even rockets can destroy the truth, still I wonder, whether a virus is as dangerous as a tooth.

title: Whisper
body:
Just whisper

I can hear you thousands of miles away

With my pulsating blister

How will we deceive me today?

Just think my name because sound is much too slow- no what it took to make...

Again, listening to the air, rather than the water and the ground. There I go-

my beautiful mistake.

I don’t dare the silence to take me to you

Nor can I see the futility of opening the minds between us with my breath

I’ll look past the travesties that destiny brought me to by the light of your door

to discern each step right and left

Don’t you think I never left that spot where I kissed you goodbye

I know you know how much I was on your line

You’re just where I want to let my moments go by- it’s so nice to know I didn’t leave your mind

Now it’s time to raise you back to your right divine

So nice of you to let me think you’re mine

For you to make an attempt to breach the grapevine to beckon my polarity from the singular hilarity

And so again this device leads me to call out to you

title: Tattoo me
body:
Tattoo me

Right under your nose

Because it’s not fair

I’ll always have to share you.

Fighting the urge to pull you from them

Until I realize I’ve been pushing you up and away all along.

Why’d you go back to the devils garden?

You don’t need to see those roses again.

For the truth to reach the ends of the earth, you must take it in your own hands and go.

And each step you take is met with the demands of the low- that’s your rest.

If only my behest were at my behest...

Your words say, I can’t tell, that we’ll see in hours or weeks- never if I say the wrong thing.

Thus I transmute to suit these approaching peaks pleading with the darkness to forgive the heartless-

Reminding myself that it’s not just a thing

“Send me your address again.”

She’s driving blind so she won’t let you unwind, as long as there’s your sight to win.

Isn’t it nice to know I’m one of the reasons you can’t sleep tonight.

Sure, nobody can tell you what to do, so why do they keep trying?

Maybe it’s because you won’t do anything right- first question why they’re dying.

title: Cry
body:
Cry because I shouldn’t need to tell you why

These old words all are different now

By the time you let me see you,

you’re already disappearing.

Keep me away from those Gemini eyes

Sift me from the rubble of the springtime

This might just be the next best part,

I can’t wait to go back to being blind.

Nobody ever told me it was a thing

Let’s go to mars to make a Pisces-

But I won’t let you take the joy out of my love

or paint my longing with the foolish guilt so maliciously bequeathed to you from your misremembered antagonists because I know you are more then the shell of a person you pretend to be.

The sharp edges you carved into the past cut jaggedly at the flesh that’s no longer mine- formed by your taught malice, fed by empty arteries. So, I’ll pretend I haven’t already shaken it off though I’m just mad at this painful train that you can’t forget. Meanwhile, you’re so impressed with your own languid cruelty that you miss the point that your beloved transgressions don’t bleed me because the only thing wrong is that you still can’t realize that you need to be here now.

title: Surviving
body:
This ultimate feeling

It can’t last long

It’s the calm of acceptance of everything wrong

The acknowledgment that there’s much left to do in the face of impossibly and all it’s infinite features stacked up to wazoo.

What we’ve got on our side, is fleeting

But it’s always something nonetheless.

Who wants to hear words repeating?

In your company, I feel blessed.

What’s to stop me from sharing?

Or you from comparing- the sun to the moon?

Could it happen too soon?

Chipping away in hemp at those who keep the sump from draining

Offering alternatives to the maiming that has grown too commonplace.

Surviving against misappropriations and disgrace until it’s time to take their place.

title: Antiquated Guts
body:
Are you taken aback?

With your being pushed to the front?

Have you succeeded in rearranging what it is that you want?

How much can it make and how much will it take to not break?

Would the woodwork work?

Antiquated Guts.

Get back to me shortly

Before it’s too late

Don’t bore me with tall tales of entitlement and fate while I’m feeding infinity,

You say it’s too late.

Antiquated guts

It’s just the best idea to exist

to weave and to reap, to feel and to seep

Through the lines that divide us

The times that try us are worth

Inevitable victory.

Though it seems they act contradictorily

They behave, in fact, metaphorically

Antiquated Guts

Deny that I exist for your eyes

Let me try to peel off your disguise

As far as they can criticize

Your wars and figurines.

Antiquated Guts

Ask the silver maid, it’s true

How can I expect from you

While I’m busy architecting trust

From the remnants of intent

Tell me where you went

Antiquated Guts

title: The deal.
body:
What a task to deal with equilibrium

As constants perpetually change

A dutiful undertaking of beauty to keep one

From being deranged.

What an undertaking balancing

domain and polarity- practicing practicality.

In the presence of a great evil,

Lesser evil forms together common good.

Though the cycle continues;

as commonality contrives malevolence.

Individualisticism cannot exist perpetually

As sure as gravity, the funambulist

eventually falls.

The answer, that I’m still formulating

To be skeptical and to trust and repeat.

Giving one a chance to be more.

Belief is just that. Then there’s action.

title: I turned around
body:
Wading through immeasurable zine-

The murky depth of delegation.

Keeping score of cooperation just in case

the world is harsher than it appears to us.

Responsibilities offering sweet distraction

Eyes and bodies moving in frantic harmony.

Get me a coconut, a pear and the news

that whatever I ask will be ignored with rouse

Hate me as I practice walking away.

With the world in front of me,

today I turned around

tomorrow I come clean

Never cease to amaze me

With the power I awaken in you.

title: Sometimes, you just have to invent words.
body:
Be not afraid, brave sequesterer

Belief is the resource that must be attained through any means necessary

Each set of hands, the universal mind expresses

Learning each second how to unsquander the last

Or else live blind and empty

There cannot exist typlotic regard

Unignoring my fate

Of finding favorful flavor

While dredging through distraction

In order to facilitate virtuous action.

title: Poem
body:
What could I ask of you

That you’d gladly want to do

Dutifully and beautifully

Can anything that’s said

Truthfully and toothfully

Ever speak fully to reality

Show me everything you know

To show me what you know of nothing

Squeeze me tight if you’re not bluffing

All I can ask but I’m not asking

Is to take your task of basking

Through the heights and droplets

The nights and gauntlets

And steps to take back from them

Your infinite destiny

title: Decay
body:
I choose life.

That’s all the say I have

I have to say

Not because I want to

There is no other way.

With the arms of a clown

Smiling heart and livid mind

Can’t you see

This music’s not for me

I’m just going blind

All the chances there are

Bar none

As bad as it can get

It’s as good as done

One is enough today

Or so they say

As I’m digging aimlessly

for more gusto

in the frayed remnants of desire

title: Serial we
body:
And when the glass shatters

As you pretend it’s okay

Did you ever think it could be another way?

What’s the point of playing when you’re blind to the rules

Who would want to be with someone who humiliates fools?

I guess you see me as a joke

As I see you and blink away the tears that you pretend don’t exist

You make me think that I wish I were better

Until your cold shoulder reminds me

That you’re just one of them trying to be different

That you could never be what I want you to be

And that I’m in awe about how I could never want you to be different from how you are.

If there’s ever been a glimpse at truth

It’s been seen by the heart

To take from disregard,

that which is seemingly infinite

And to treasure it obsessively.

I wish to disseminate the beam of my vision that lights up the eyes of strangers.

All I know is, they always look away.

And then there’s you. The end of my rope.

That which my pathetic mind still grasps for.

The tantalizing disassociated serenity that rests between our hands

And disappears like a speck of dust in a tornado

What would time do to us?

How about one more chance to disengage

Before the serial we.

title: How about a fucking poem
body:
What abut that time you said what needed to be heard

Or can you conveniently forget

The times you dared to be defied and tried to cash in on your bet

How about it? That it never meant a thing

Are you so above, the ones you love, that you can’t even sing?

How about a fucking poem then

Like the ones you wrote off before

Count your lies and practice your ties

Or paint outside your door

And those things you didn’t do

are way worse than those you did

You know you can’t expect to love without a winning bid

title: So I’ll marry the moon
body:
And so I’ll marry the moon

With a background of stars

Knowing love is more than distraction

Gaining and losing traction

Finding new ways to build

a non exclusive faction

For those who connect the dots

And those for action

What’s mine is (h)ours

title: Time, it turns.
body:
The time it turns

Taking hold of the earth

I take on its momentum

Blasting through quantum space

Millennia in seconds

I am just

a resonator of the universe.

Words bounce around aiming for their mark-

Ears of the willing to concede.

For those willing to bane all thoughts

(It is not as though they cannot think)

The impossibility of the universe like pedals in the wind

Falls at their feet for all to see.

Just as every fact is true for you and you alone

Just as lies melt away in the light.

For you to cast a thought in my direction

Once felt as a freight train

Now bounce off and tickle me

As I steal your soul.

To be who you are in the face of what you aren't

is enough for a truly happy life.

Ideas and plans matter only to those who try to stand in your way.

Life is as magical as you believe

It is.

You never know who's watching,

More importantly, you never need to turn around to see.

And the ticking of the clock

Serves only to make us fools

Until eternity

title: It was an accident, sorry.
body:
For these third five years of consent

I’ll go in between

The bold assurance of the first

And the humble lessons of the second

Take me you city of scoundrels

With all your harrowing deeds

Fill my empty heart with water

So I can sow my seeds

To not forget forever

Whilst constantly searing in

nothing and never

I want you in every way

title: She
body:
She

Holds the divine like a burning coal

Tightened jaw begetting unspoken truth

She

Speaks not of the wind

Just lets it fill her sails

She

Dances when the eyes she longs for

are closing

Smiles when there are no other eyes to please

She says

fall

Fall in

Fall in love.

title: A wind tunnel
body:
I live in a wind tunnel

Buy which is defined

The point is just

Outside?

Either it’s out there or in here-

Is the joke

But it is not.

Who put the shoes on your feet?

Really who?

the vile things they’ve done to you

What will you do? Whatever you will do.

And who pays for what is to be true.

So while they wonder what wonder is

for wonders sake

I can smile

To give and take a while

To redefine life

To think

What thinking is

For who

Because they simply will not do.

I live in a wind tunnel.

It billows me up

And like so, I sink

So we fly

Forevermore into nevertheless.

title: The dance
body:
Folding and unfolding

It’s the human way

Speak your mind as your heart dwindles

Fight through silly thought spindles

She asks not of the past,

dreams not of the future

See how your plans fade into us

Sweet, sullen, beautiful and free.

Follow fast, leaving behind shadows cast

Gaunt lips fastened? Get on the bus to see

And she will lead, and he will lead

Pulling to coerce the pliant meadow

And they will plant, and we will seed

Quelling the earth with water

to feed the mountains.

title: Rage on.
body:
Battle, battle.

Rage on-

The body of the fight between

head and brain and mind.

Can't you see how life's defined?

By those who step beyond the lines.

All there is to know, and not

Is one and one and one.

And all there is to do is time;

Walking in your own shoes,

Beckoning the night, the day

and everyone who's in between-

And giving it a shot.

Victory is self preservation.

Sovereignty defeating greed.

Rationality digging trenches through the laughingly chaotic universe

attempting to paint it sane, in vain.

We know no rest.

Assured by nobody, tempted by few.

Our fate sits in our own hands,

but we must stand to keep it.

As human we reserve the right to be.

Being prepared to speak to freedom

Without needing to talk down or up.

Ask only of me

That which you cannot learn from the wind.

title: Hot and Cold life
body:
I know I'm absurd

Quite clearly I'm hooked.

It's the only way I know

How to finish a book.

Yes I'm a fool, trapped in his vice

I've got to stay on top

no matter the price

Wasted precious moments

The cloud of sleep

When I can't move a muscle

They tell me I'm weak.

Born to die, just like you all

Too impatient to fade away

I'll answer your call

I want to reach out

Tell you I'm fine

But when you're not here

I can't find my mind

I feel you quite clearly

I know that you're there

I've got all these feelings

I don't know how to share

The tide, It is growing

I cannot give in

You give me a reason

Not to forget how to swim

Tell me when I'm worthy

Show me the time

I'll give you my best

Just tell me that you're mine

Now that it's over, it's time to begin

Found where I'm lost

Hot and cold life that I'm in.

title: The New York Love Exchange
body:
Dollars and sense.

Makes cents to agree.

NO amount of paper is enough to set me free.

I thrive within the moment,

dive within the air.

Perfection’s all around,

If they tell you to be there.

The currency of life is daring away death.

It’s all I got to say, until theres nothing left.

I’ve found the cost of freedom,

though it sounds absurd;

Is letting go of numbers,

and feeling into words.

Holding onto programmed phrases,

Polishing up our pretty cages,

Tricked into feeling warm.

Hedging bets of petty vets drowns out crying of the pests

'till they’re satiated with plastic corn.

title: For the first time
body:
For the first time,

time has real meaning; just as I let it go.

For the last time, I’ve got no place to go.

It’s just one word I still can’t say

I’ve known you over many lifetimes, though every time I see you,

it feels like we’ve just met.

Fish gather in our wake, our world is an ocean.

Waiting to turn; just for you and I.

A pair of quarks with the same spin.

I push down, you pull up.

I freeze at the top. You melt at the bottom.

States change, but time remains nonexistent.

Chaos dances between our words and actions.

Still, above all; we share a deep understanding of the sublime.

A charming dynamic.

Unstable, strange and insatiable.

Quantum entanglement can’t keep us apart for long.

Then I blink and it disappears.

The harshness of reality seeps in. The words I had to say disappear.

Off I go into the dark abyss of my mind.

Spiraling between dimensions, grasping desperately for the light.

The wind blows until I cannot stand.

I let go just to not drag you down with me.

And then, as my last ray of hope slips into the darkness,

You appear out of the heavens, and the sun and stars fall to our feet.

Jumping between dimensions, laughing in the face of time-space.

Bringing the wind with a blink of your eye,

and fire with the tip of your hand.

I’m the biggest joke in the world

and you’re the only one who knows

it’s not funny.

To keep it alive I close my eyes and ears;

following only my heart.

It’s all I have.

To believe in you is all I need, all I have to keep me going.

title: Idiot.
body:
The universe lies at my feet begging to be picked up and run with. Still I sit looking down upon it as it writhes crying.

If you want this, then you'll have to do that, it tells me.

Why wouldn't you want that? It asks me.

Then I realize that I'm just talking to myself and it laughs at me.

I smile back just to show my fury.

Idiot.

title: Wednesday evening train ride
body:
If the world was as it seems

And time, as good as chasing dreams

Reality couldn’t matter.

If minutes were years

And footsteps were tears

The space between would last forever.

If words were meant to make you smile;

If feelings fleeting could last a mile;

Then the ground on which I walk to you is the clouds.

If thoughts were real like dollar bills,

I’d stack them on the windowsills

Just to stay living in the dark

Until you bring the light.

But since this world is oh so small,

Filled with faces and places to fall;

The truth is never true for long.

Everywhere you go, and everything you do,

There will always be someone waiting to prove you wrong.

I don’t need proof, lucky for me;

My world’s as clear as I can’t see.

Anything you want to do, is as certain as dirt getting on your shoe.

What they think and what they say, if it matters, that’s up to you.

Happy Birthday!

Greg Castro

03/30/2016

title: The way I live
body:
This is the way I live.

 Making educated guess after miseducated guess.

Never knowing anything for sure, always needing more

reeling, too depressed to face the test.

Constantly behind, rushing at the last second to do everything.

It's just the way I am.

Stubborn red and lonely.

Don't let me give myself away.

I'm so stoked to be where I'm going, I let where I am slip away.

Sometimes I've got it. Everything and everyone I need.

Then there comes the time where I'm supposed to see other people. Or so I think.

I don't know how to choose. I hate them all, especially the ones that I love.

Is it better to disappoint them rather than choose one to make happy?

Why do I even feel like it's my choice to choose?

So limited by by words. Can't express how I feel about you.

All the ways I could reach you have been stripped away. I fall into dark despair and I don't mind.

The feeling of coming back into the light is well worth it.

title: The light
body:
I'm blind to the light, all I see is refraction.

Stuck on the wall from my latest retraction.

Wounded warrior spent from battling his only enemy, distraction.

The past is a black hole.

When you've reached the speed of light, it's too late to slow down.

There's something about those blasted photons that sting my eyes.

The only way to tell the truth is to say nothing.

There's no avoiding the light.

Still, I try.

In the dark it's much warmer. At least then I know what to do.

title: The Hunter
body:
The Hunter emerges slowly, burned by his own trap.

How long had he been gone?

The answer never seemed to matter.

Snow falling at his feet, bow broken, limply hanging on his right side.

Dusting off his coat, taking his first breath.

Too unbearable to comprehend.

No time to remember how to exist.

Fire. Burning all around him.

His first step shakes the earth. Trees fall in his wake.

The birds gather in his shadow.

The flames call, but he no longer answers.

Winter’s whisp still binding the spring.

Had he not heard himself call his own demise?

Not stopping to wonder if he should wipe the blood from his eyes.

Loud footsteps shake the trees. Pushing out his last bit of life to remain apart from the forest.

His next play to forget his game. Long ago stopped wishing they’d remember his name.

Powerful silence sinks from the top of a mountain.

It starts with a drop.

Two drops.

Suddenly there are no numbers.

Instantly there are no words.

The snow is the rain.

The rain becomes the fire.

There is no he.

There is no they.

There is no there.

Divinity. Despair. Frozen. In silence.

title: The Empire Circuit.
body:
The empire circuit runs the city no matter what time of year. Just grab a ticket and float on by.

Omnipotent city, dressed in extravagant trappings of mystery, history and sorrow.

Laughing in the face of the fool dancing in boots, bold enough to dream about tomorrow.

Hope boils down to the only truth, revealed to be lost in a haze of winters menacing reality. The universe opens her landscape; tempestuous magnetic spell melting ice with green light. Her hands do the leading, kneading uncovered earth. A spark becomes thunder building charge to fire. Tuning into your vibration, the room warms concentrating pressure as you tempt me to hedge my bet. Ice melts into water, dripping through the cracks; drenched leather current shaping weather. Heaven's clouds catch the wind, fluid force oscillating around a common equilibrium.

title: As if it even matters.
body:
Quite reproachable, this insanity of mine.

Watching, waiting to tug open the seams of reality.

Yesterday's cage outgrown.

Striding by cold painful "truths" that still cast shadows of shackles,

I fight the boundaries of time and space as if it is the only craft.

These days, my world ends quite often.

Feeling too at home in the 5th dimension.

I no longer worry if I am able to wake up to the universe surrounding me.

I am an illusion casting my illusory spell as I pass before you.

But what I'm eluding to is different to whoever perceives me.

Bold passionate existence.

Uncompromising in the face of pity or distraction.

Solitude outranks latitude and longitude.

Living for feeling like its my only life. Fleeing to stay still.

The plight shines brightly standing tall against the rain instead of running away.

The pain feels as good as it does to feel.

You appear like a sphere of glowing light.

Pulling me out of my misery with your frequency.

You know words are as useless as wishes.

Action or stillness at the right time is all there is.

My silly mind sometimes forgets where I am and who I am...

As if that even matters!!

title: 99 Sense
body:
Talk is cheap.

I got called a sheep

By a pig.

I call out to you shepards for guidance.

I know.

Everything is.

Synergistic

Systematic

cataclysmic.

Everyone else seems to be chasing dollars when all they need is

99 sense.

Yesterday never happened

I dare you to prove me wrong.

While you stop to check

I'm cashing in on tomorrow.

Never slowing down until I hear my name.

Then I move faster.

title: I must be home
body:
Let me read your mind

I've got all the time I could need

No place to go, no more space time to waste

Into the unknown with the hope I find a place

To live

To die

A thousand times

And never wish to be anywhere.

It's a wish come true just to be rite here.

My return to the promised land is all I wish for. To fly over the gates of the other side.

Incense burns and I'm frozen in time.

I'm seeing molecules dancing in the stars again, I must be home.

title: Tea
body:
I wonder what I was thinking when I opened the door…

What was I expecting?

She came back inside.

Saying she left her glasses in my room

while wearing them on her head.

I offered her tea.

But she left before I poured it.

What I meant to offer her was the universe.

Tea was easier to say.

title: You need to be mine.
body:
She's a part of me

I can't deny.

Close your eyes and wonder why.

One of these days

You'll come

And my back door won't be open.

Two dreamers who can't face reality

Dead but afraid.

Blindly searching, swimming in circles.

Oh but how sweet is the current.

If you would let me, I could.

But time laughs in our faces

A cruel joke.

My mind it runs

Until it reaches yours

My body's pain it ignores

It's the same every time

I want you.

All of you.

I need to be yours.

You need to be mine.

Let's just pretend that's not true

And kill ourselves

Trying to bring the world down with us.

title: Surely, this must be it.
body:
The world is closing in.

I bet you wouldn't know

I know you wouldn't care.

The voices running through my mind warn me to beware.

They say that I'll destroy myself

I say that's the only way.

Feeling strange from playing lonely games,

It's time to die my way.

What's there to look forward to?

Suburban hell?

It's come down to

Existential suicide

or

burning in a cell.

I love to hate who I've become I've known it all along.

A fool who's only satisfaction

is waiting for a song.

How could I capture lifetimes worth of pain and joy.

The rush of feeding ego and the passion to destroy.

I can only feel with my back against the wall.

You say I'm free to be, but I'm still waiting for your call.

I thought I learned my lesson.

I thought I'd changed my brain.

No matter what I do, it always goes the same.

You're the bane of my existence,

That's until I see your face.

One second I'm the king of the world, the next and I'm disgraced.

I gave you too much power

To know just how I break.

You destroy me oh so well

How much more can I take?

title: Mind v. Body
body:
My mind wanders but there's only so many places it can go

I try to reel it in but instead it grows.

There’s certain times, when what I need to remember, comes flashing to my eyes.

But, as soon as I try to hold on it slips away just as I realize.

I’m not so good at this thinking thing, though I do it all the time.

Doing, I think, is much easier, though I’m blind to the sublime.

I guess you could say my mind has a mind of its own.

It doesn’t like changing gears.

You’d think I’d know how to work it, after all these years.

I turn and turn and going nowhere fast, instead of taking my time to make the present last.

I am who I am, and that’s all that I can be.

But who I am tomorrow is not determined just by me.

My fate is not cast in stone, but its starting to mold.

Only by taking control can my will take a hold.

Silly body, won’t you listen?

title: dleiafteh
body:
I live

                and

                               I die.

Still, each

    time

                               I'm surprised.

what I know

                               is dwarfed by

W h a T                 I   f o r g e t.

Still...

                               each time

   IT   always  s e e m s to matter

Until you remind me

                                                    It's only a wave.

title: the Lion
body:
The lion runs,

not worrying about catching his mane in the wind.

For how can a lion worry?

However far a Lion runs,

it is as if he never took a step.

But what becomes of a Lion when he stops?

When he stops becoming a lion?

How can he be a lion?

He is the dust swirled from his steps.

He is the wind that pulls up the dust.

And when he forgets he is a Lion,

he will be reminded by everything that ever was and will be.

until he forgets again...

title: The Void
body:
The void.

it calls to me.

closer, it whispers...

Give in.

You've done all you can.

close your eyes...

the only way not to despise what you see.

I call out in protest, but can only find silence

scrambling to rise as fast as I can sink.

The clock taunts me.

It's no use.

What is left in this dimension besides suffering?

silence.

Darkness creeps around the edges, whispering its victory song.

title: Infatuated with insanity
body:
I care, I think… because I feel. I don’t normally.

I like to pretend that I never met you

except when you get stuck in my mind.

I find myself thinking about you.

the fact that you exist.

 it makes me smile.

I think of all the reasons I can’t see you.

I know just how I’ll feel when you say that you don't want me.

Such a silly man.

Infatuated with insanity.

I guess I should write you a song, but I’m no good.

Except when you’re around, then I think I could.

If only you’d give me a chance…

a chance to what?

to put my foot in my mouth.

I know where this ends and its not worth the pain.

I’d rather just smile every time your name crosses my brain.

title: When I stop trying
body:
That's it. I’m done trying to be who I’m not.

They say a poet should be well read.

Well, I’m well red.

I’m in no position to complain.

I live in a nice house with a nice couch, a tv, a refrigerator and a grouch.

I have a place to sleep. I have food to eat.

I’m comfortable.

Kill me now before it gets any worse.

Comfort makes me uncomfortable.

I can’t think of a worse nightmare than waking up in a house I’m struggling to pay the mortgage of

by working a job that I hate, to feed the mouths of satan’s spawns

to be bitched at by someone who I used to love

because I’ve become fat and stale.

Don’t be so hard on humanity, my brain tells me.

Being human is not what I have a problem with

Its the expectations associated with being human.

The way I treat people…

I don’t deserve to have the love of my family.

I don’t deserve to have any friends.

Still the people won’t let me be.

“We want the best for you.” they say.

“We’re glad to have you back.”

Who’s best do you want for me?

I don’t belong to you. You can never have me.

Whats wrong with wanting to live for myself?

I would rather die than be told how to live my life.

It’s my life. It’s the only thing I have worth having.

I respect the way you live, why can’t you respect me?

Believe in your god. Believe in your government.

I don’t judge your delusions, so don’t judge mine.
